name: Mosaic Pop
contribution: A relaxing mobile-first tile-collection puzzle prototype.
headline: Collect tiles. Restore the mosaic.
summary: Mosaic Pop is a mobile-first puzzle prototype where players collect scrambled coloured tiles, place them back onto matching mosaic squares, and advance through a sequence of target colours.
body: The board starts as a fixed pixel-art mosaic with glossy bubbles scattered across the wrong squares. Players tap bubbles into a small buffer, then place each tile back onto a matching background square to rebuild the artwork. The prototype includes target-colour progression, simple boosters, fly-to-tray animations, sound toggles, and a compact touch-friendly layout.
